Vendored browser media libraries

mediabunny 1.65.2 (MPL-2.0)
@mediabunny/ac3 1.65.2 (MPL-2.0; bundled FFmpeg AC-3/E-AC-3 codec under LGPL-2.1)
@mediabunny/aac-encoder 1.65.2 (MPL-2.0; bundled FFmpeg AAC codec under LGPL-2.1)

These are the minified ESM builds from the npm packages, copied into public/ so WatchLaro needs no frontend build step.
